name: jc_2d_crosssolver_coarse
scope: Quasi-2D plane-strain JC strip for Abaqus/Explicit versus VUMAT-PD cross-solver verification

boundarySets.rigidBodySuppression: one lateral component at the support-centre particle

materialComparisonCaveat: Internal state variables are model-specific observers and are not mapped to a common bond-breaking rule.
parameterMatchingPolicy: Only identifiable macroscopic properties are matched; formulation-specific or hard-coded parameters are not claimed to be equivalent.
legacyBlockPolicy: Material-independent fixed-width blocks of 256 points; a non-full final block duplicates its last valid point and discards padded outputs.
